div.head: II Cn 30.4
div.ab: And æt þam oðrum cyrre ne si þær nan oðer bót, gif he fúl wurðe, butan þæt man ceorfe him ða handa [of] oððe ða fet oððe ægþer, be þam ðe seo dæd sig.
And æt þam oðrum cerre ne sy þær nan oðor bot, gif he ful wurðe, buton þæt man ceorfe him þa handa of oððe þa fet oððe ægðer, be þam þe seo dæde sy.
Ad secundam uicem non sit alia emendatio, si reus fuerit, nisi ut amputentur ei manus aut pedes aut utrumque, secundum quod factum erit.
And æt ðam oðran cyrre ne sy ðær nan oþer bot, gyf he ful wurðe, buton ðæt man ceorfe him ða handa oððe ða fǽt óf oððe ægðer, be ðam ðe seo dæd sy.
And æt þam oðrum cyrre, ne si þær nan oðer bot gif he ful wurðe butan þæt man ceorfe him ða handa oððe þa fet oððe ægþer, be þam ðe seo dæd sig.
Und wenn er zum zweiten Male schuldig befunden wird, gebe es keine andere Busse, als dass man ihm die Hände oder die Füsse oder beides abhaue, je nachdem die That ist.
And if he is found guilty the second time, let there be no other compensation than that his hands or his feet or both be cut off, according to what the deed is.
And on the second occasion, if he is proved guilty, there shall be no compensation possible to him but to have his hands or his feet cut off or both, according to the nature of the offence.
And on the second occasion there is to be no other compensation, if he is convicted, but that his hands, or feet, or both, in proportion to the deed, are to be cut off.
And if he is proven guilty a second time, there shall be no other possible compensation except to have his hands or feet cut off or both, according to the seriousness of the crime.
div.note: ‘of’ should probably be supplied in G from the other MSS. Liebermann compares I Atr 1.6.
